claims.reason: The charge was noncash and largely intangible, but it reflected revised future economic lives and cash-flow assumptions. Dismissing it as just accounting would lose real information about expected franchise erosion.

evidence.title: BAT 2023 annual report
evidence.finding: 2023 US impairment totaled about GBP 27.3 bn, including GBP 4.3 bn goodwill and GBP 23 bn mainly combustibles brands. Brand useful lives became 20-30 years rather than indefinite, reflecting revised economic expectations; non-cash does not mean economically meaningless.

assessment: Bitcoin appreciation and the global PMI upturn support explicit forecasts; the 2024 value rotation did not materialize. AXP and BTI were strong selections in the observed window, while Cigna lagged heavily. Dividend-adjusted PEG is a useful screening adjustment, but does not make unlike business risks equivalent. The tobacco impairment contained economic information despite being noncash. Swan claims require independent private-company verification, especially given the disclosed director and equity relationship. OMAB and Brazil five-year views remain open.
